new_problems: Performance: GET /projects now computes each card's status (loadTaskDisplayContext, open cards, intake status, and workingOn which reads up to 10 000 events of a running session) per project; in polling mode the UI re-reads it when the Inbox count moves or a session starts/ends. Fine for a few projects; with many projects or long sessions consider caching the current task on the session row (packages/runtime/src/daemon/project-status.ts workingOn).

The session log lines themselves are still raw where system-text has not reworded them (screenshot 11: '**Summary** [stand-in model] …', 'Gave 1 item(s) from the next-session queue', 'Critic: accepted (grade 86, 0 finding(s), 0 open)'). system-text owns describeEvent/event-lines.ts this wave.

The Overview's Decisions section (DecisionsSection.tsx, system-text's) still reads 'Answered questions are recorded here and not asked again unless superseded.' / 'No decisions yet.' and does not link to the decision records, which the Docs route now serves (docs/decisions/<name>.md).
Files lists the doc scaffold (docs/architecture.md, docs/data.md, ...) beside the work's files; a person may want the work first. Consider ordering by change date or grouping 'docs/' last.
The time in the session title uses the browser locale ('11:19 PM'); the design example is 24-hour ('14:05'). Locale-dependent by choice (toLocaleTimeString).
notes_for_other_areas: ProjectCard (api-types.ts) now has optional statusLine {kind: waiting|working|stuck|docker|ready|planning|planning_failed|done|empty|paused, text, action {kind: link|start, label, to}|null}, progress {done,total}, working {sessionId, agentName, taskId, taskTitle, since}|null, folder: string|null. Pure helpers in packages/runtime/src/daemon/project-status.ts: projectStatusLine, progressOf, overviewNext, workingOn, isIntakeSession. The chat (project-facts.ts) or notifications can reuse the status sentence instead of composing their own.
ProjectSummary gains next: string[] (computed when read) and lastSession.changedFiles. HumanView gains provider: string|null (null = no model: the shell's no-key bar).

New routes GET /projects/:id/files and /projects/:id/files/:path (ProjectFilesView, ProjectFileContentView; client.projectFiles/projectFile; fake and real-daemon cases). The task drawer can link a changed file to /projects/:id/files?path=<file>. GET /projects/:id/docs/:path also opens docs/decisions/<name>.md: DecisionsSection (system-text) can link 'all' to /projects/:id/docs?doc=... or open the record.
Desktop shell command invoke('open_folder', { path }) (apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/folder.rs, capabilities/folder.json); UI wrapper components/FolderPath.tsx (folderOpener()).

UI: the /events 'session.changed' frame is parsed as { event: 'session.activity', data: {type, payload} }; polling also emits 'sessions.running'. store/context.tsx coalescedRefresh keeps the project cards live; any screen can read working/statusLine from useUiState(s => s.projects).

UI: Shell nav is Home, Inbox, More ▾ (MORE_NAV in shell/ShellBars.tsx), Settings gear (role link name 'Settings'). Project tabs: PROJECT_TABS with more:true for plan/docs/reviews/costs/data inside <details data-testid='tab-more'>; the Overview keeps the route id 'summary'. Tests that click Memory/Extensions/Changes/Performance/Updates must open more-nav first.

Scheduler (session/triggers.ts) drains an agent's waiting starts when its run ends (while started). Tests in a shared describe that leave a start queued will now see it run: wait until !rt.scheduler.isActive(agent) && pendingStarts(agent).length === 0.
lib/use-hash-scroll.ts useScrollToHash(ready) scrolls to #id; Inbox cards have id card-<requestId>.
